serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise is a cloud-based offering that allows agencies to use world-class creativity apps to create and collaborate efficiently with connected desktop and mobile apps and the enterprise-grade security that federal agencies require. Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise includes 20+ creative tools across graphic design, photography, video, 3D and Augmented Reality, user interface (UI) and user experience (UX), illustration, social media, built-in templates, artificial intelligence (AI) features, cloud services, and business features. Whether developing multichannel content, doing fast photo and digital editing, designing prototypes for mobile experiences, or taking on large-scale video production, Adobe Creative Cloud offers the latest innovations in digital design tools to deliver customizable assets that meet federal agency standards. The Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise offers options for flexible deployment, identity management with Federated ID and Single Sign-On (SSO), annual license true-ups, license management tools, and enterprise-level customer support. Learn more here. https://www.adobe.com/creativecloud/business/enterprise.html
